title: glab api projects/${project}/milestones?sort=updated_desc&per_page=1
description: The project's newest milestone by update, ${project} its path URL-encoded, whose iid and updated_at make a mark with the newest issue's, since an issue closing moves no milestone's own update (forge/gitlab:marks in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh`, with forge::gitlab_marks in `modules/jq/forge.jq`). The milestones themselves are read through GraphQL, as api-graphql-milestones.schema.json gives them. The types are APIEntitiesMilestone of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/milestones in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/milestones/ describes them.

id.description: The milestone's own, which its issues are listed by.
